steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: In all the stories I have told, people's wishes and regrets always fall into the same motifs.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Birth, aging, illness, death, yearning for what they cannot have, pains of facing what they despise, and parting from what they cherish.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu reclines against the banner, her folding fan resting lightly against her cheek as she studies the little Wisp with evident fascination.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: But you're a departed soul—your attachments could not have arisen from birth, aging, or illness.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little being in your arms, already rattled by Yugu's Mania fluctuations, grows even more speechless under her scrutinizing gaze.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You cradle it gently as you begin asking questions, hoping to eliminate some possibilities.

options: Were you murdered in your past life?
Were you a Sinner when you were alive?
Did you have someone you deeply loved?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did you have any enemies or people who wished you harm?

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: N-no, I... I didn't have any. Everyone was always kind to me...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wait, what did they call Sinners where you were from?

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: I don't really understand that word, but I don't think that was the case...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A childhood sweetheart, love at first sight, or maybe a soulmate?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Upon hearing these words, the little Wisp tilts its form in confusion, clearly unfamiliar with such concepts. It's evident that it has never experienced anything of the sort.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: As you struggle to formulate your next question, Yugu suddenly breaks the silence.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: How about this, little one? I shall narrate a tale, and all you must do is respond with a simple yes or no.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu gently caresses her taleteller's clapper, her gaze lowered in contemplation.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: You were drawn into the Hazy Fete in a Daze... Your lingering attachment must be connected to that fateful star of calamity.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I have wandered through all of Eastia, listening to myriad cries of sorrow and words of delusion beneath ill-fated stars. Surely I can piece together your unique tragedy.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: A sharp tap echoes through the air as Yugu strikes her taleteller's clapper against the stone pavement. The sound cuts through your thoughts, drawing all attention to her presence.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The world around you is shrouded in shifting shadows, but as Yugu's words flow forth, reality slowly takes on new forms. It's as if she's not merely changing the world around you, but drawing you into her tale entirely.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Lend your ears to this elegant verse, as I weave a tale of a beloved maiden—

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Within this narrative, there resided a mansion of opulent riches—adorned with vermilion gates and carved beams, crowned with gilded roofs and jeweled halls, encompassing expansive courtyards where ornate fountains danced, and housing vast chambers brimming with innumerable treasures.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: One blessed day, as divine light painted the heavens in splendor, a daughter was born to the household. From her first breath, she was showered with boundless affection, treasured like the rarest jewel by every soul within the estate.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The young lady grew to be a vision of beauty, with features like delicate brushstrokes and skin like pristine snow. Born to privilege, she flourished amidst splendor—adorned each day with fresh jewels, clothed in the finest silks. Her table brimmed with the rarest delicacies and the freshest seasonal fruits.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Such a blessed life of luxury, all the world's love lavished upon one soul... How it stirs such burning envy, makes one wish to tear flesh from bone, to take her place, or perhaps to crawl inside the moth...

steps.speaker: Option
options: Interrupt her

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hold on, we're getting off track.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: As the eerily lifelike mist begins to materialize the grotesque scene from Yugu's tale, you quickly put a stop to it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So basically, this is about a child born into a wealthy family, living a happy life, cherished and doted on by her parents, right?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yes, little one. In the beginning, you must have had such a home of joy and warmth too, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little Wisp bounces happily in your arms, clearly delighted.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Yes, yes! That's right! I remember now!

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: My home was just like she described! My mom and dad loved me so much!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Yu, shall we read this story before bed tonight?

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: It's about a kind person who saved an injured phoenix in the depths of winter. In return, the phoenix blessed their village with bountiful crops, ensuring that the people would never go hungry. Thus, the village became a paradise on earth.

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: You're going to grow up to be just as honest and kind, Yu.

steps.speaker: Young Yugu
steps.content: Yes, Mother! Please, please read me the story!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Very well, I shall make note of this clue.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu taps her folding fan against her taleteller's clapper, and the sharp, clear sound draws your attention back to her.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: In this noble household, the loving couple lived in perfect harmony. Their daughter, upon first learning of human nature, witnessed how her parents treated each other with utmost respect. From them she learned that to receive kindness, one must first show kindness to others.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: They taught their daughter to look beyond social status, encouraging her to follow her heart's calling.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And so the young lady made friends far and wide, regardless of their wealth or status. Each was a person of exceptional character and talent. They not only resonated with her passions but also embraced her essence—occasionally steering her away from frivolity and at times, listening attentively to her deepest musings.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Her very being, it was agreed by all who knew her, infused their lives with immeasurable joy.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little Wisp in your arms, moved by the tale, suddenly struggles free and rushes toward Yugu. You rub your eyes in disbelief as you watch the little Wisp, under Yugu's power, slowly take on a human form.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: That's exactly right! My friends were wonderful to me too!

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: We supported each other, encouraged each other... They were truly wonderful friends!

steps.speaker: Young Yugu
steps.content: Mother, Father, what does it really mean to be happy?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Let me think... Happiness is being loved by your parents, cherished by your friends, enjoying delicious food, and finding comfort in good books. All these things can bring happiness.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: What made you ask such a question, Yu?

steps.speaker: Young Yugu
steps.content: My friend said happiness is something that makes you tremble with joy, but I feel like... I've never experienced that...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Oh, sweetheart! That's because you're surrounded by happiness every day. You're just so used to feeling it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: From what we've seen, could your lingering attachment be to these happy memories from when you were alive?

steps.speaker: Cyrus
steps.content: So to help you find peace... would you like to see your parents and friends one last time?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little Wisp wavers uncertainly, its response lacking its previous conviction.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: I... I'm not really sure. If what you said was true, I should have remembered what I wanted right away.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Take it easy, little one.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu gently caresses the little Wisp, and her mesmerizing voice once again reaches your ears.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Allow me to narrate the conclusion... then, you may delve once more into your memories...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Dark clouds roll in like an encroaching storm, and your hands instinctively clench—you know what kind of tale Yugu is about to unfold.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet even as the maiden came of age, she had never found anything that brought true happiness to her heart.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: However, fate is a fickle master. One fateful year, the heavens themselves changed. Crimson clouds painted the sky as a massive star of ill omen plummeted to earth. The world descended into chaos as monsters arose, leaving devastation in their wake.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Her parents sought to flee the chaos and calamity with their daughter, never imagining that the anguish and hardship they encountered would be forever etched in the maiden's eyes, settling deep within her heart.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Crimson light floods the heavens, while flames rage and blood spills, accompanied by piercing screams of torment and the chilling sounds of devouring—truly a hell on earth. This is no mere story, but a catastrophe that actually befell this world.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: When the protective walls her parents built around her crumbled, she ventured forth among the masses, their bodies and souls scarred by catastrophe.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: She offered food and medicine, bowing her head with feigned tenderness, all to hear their heart-rending tales. All to savor that exquisite agony that shattered her soul and sent shivers of dark pleasure through her body...

steps.speaker: Servant A
steps.content: Master! The young lady has returned! But—but!!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You... you want to stay here?! With these monsters?!

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: What nonsense are you talking about, Yu? You...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My mind is made up, Father.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I know I have failed you both, betraying the years of loving care you have bestowed upon me, dear Father and Mother... Thus...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The daughter, kneeling formally before the steps, brandished a sharp dagger. With a resolute hand, she sliced open her abdomen, extracted a piece of bone, and carved out a chunk of living flesh.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: A pitch-black mist howled like a beast as it enveloped her wound, licking at the edges of the cut.

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: Monster... You're just like them! You've become a monster!!!

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: You're not our daughter anymore!!!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: As I depart to pursue what I yearn for... I... can no longer linger by your side to bring you joy as a dutiful child... My sin is truly unforgivable...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And so, I offer my flesh and bone... as my final...

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Go now. I'll have someone gather your belongings and valuables.

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: I've always known you are bright and independent, with your own beliefs different from ours. If this is what you wish, then go pursue your path.

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: I only wish... that you would remember us.

steps.speaker: Servant A
steps.content: M-my lady... Master and Madam asked me to give this to you...

steps.speaker: Servant A
steps.content: After you left, they were... despondent day after day. In the end, they couldn't withstand the misfortune brought by that ill-fated star...

steps.speaker: Servant A
steps.content: On their deathbed, they entrusted this to me... asked me to deliver it if I ever found you... The household is no more now... My lady, I've fulfilled my duty, and it's time for me to go...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Inside the package left by the loyal servant, she found a blackened bone and a lustrous jade pendant.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Under the crimson-stained sky, where countless cries merged into one, her body trembled amidst her tears. Her limbs grew weak, and her heart felt as though it had been carved by knives.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yet amidst the devastation, she broke into laughter—this was it, the sensation she had sought for years. Her soul trembled with an indescribable bliss, and never had she felt more viscerally alive than in that moment of ultimate revelation.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I am indeed... a monster.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The woman murmured these words to herself, then gathered up her small bundle and turned back toward the inferno, stepping once more into that purgatory.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Even the most enduring bliss and delight are ephemeral instants, merely casting faint imprints upon the surface of recollection.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Only the agony of loss and the torment of regret can linger in the depths of memory, etching eternal scars.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, you... wish to return to the time before the tragedy?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or do you wish to prevent such tragedies from happening again?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The clouds cease their movement, and in an instant, the fleeing crowds and their screams freeze in place. Even breathing seems suppressed by some invisible force.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You feel your heartbeat accelerating as the shackles within your body begin to violently tremble, sending sharp pains through your nerves.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Beside you, Yugu raises her taleteller's clapper to her chest. With slightly reddened eyes, she begins to speak softly.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: No, what she truly desired was destruction...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: A deep rumble suddenly explodes into being. Everything that was frozen lurches into motion as red light flashes through the air and the wind begins to howl like a mourning dirge.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Yugu, stop!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: After all... not everyone yearns for a perfect ending where all live happily ever after together, isn't that right?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The little Wisp suddenly leaps from your arms. You instinctively rush to stop it, but it's already too late—like a calamity, it all happens in an instant.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu's whispers act like an igniting spark, stirring something within the Wisp. Like a ravenous beast, it greedily devours the surrounding Mania before transforming into a dazzling light that instantly envelops Yugu in its potent embrace.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The Wisp absorbs Yugu's power, growing increasingly stronger until it begins to overtake her presence. You can sense it merging with her, becoming one.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...I knew it. Letting you tell stories would never end well.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The humming of the shackles still echoes in your mind, your vision blurring. Despite this, you clench your teeth in determination and sprint towards Yugu.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Maybe I should just take away your pass. If you're causing trouble right under my nose, who knows what chaos you'd create if I let you out of my sight?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The fact that the little Wisp only appears within the range of Yugu's power has already led you to a subtle realization—it's targeting her power, or perhaps... its very existence is tied to Yugu herself.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: During the fete, the Wisps discovered Yugu's power to create "story worlds." Now it seeks to harness her power to craft a new tale—one where the world meets its destruction—and this narrative plays perfectly into Yugu's own desires.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu remains motionless within the ethereal mist, but the scene around her grows increasingly real as Mania seeps out. The explosions, the searing heat of flames, the screams of people—they all return, yet somehow different from before.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Some run naked through the streets, faces streaked with tears, muttering incomprehensible words as if having forsaken reason. Some clutch treasures looted from the ruins, holding them close even as flames sear their flesh as if these cold riches are their last hope for salvation.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Worse still, a group huddles together, their faces contorted and eyes wild with madness as they proclaim the coming apocalypse. This chaos becomes their stage to unleash humanity's most primal insanity.
They dance atop the ruins, raising cups and shouting, drinking wine mixed with dirt as the earth trembles and flames swallow them whole, reducing their forms to meaningless shadows.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The ground slowly ruptures, and every being in this world plummets into the abyss.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You walk through these scenes of madness step by step, until you stand at the edge of the final cliff, gazing at the sphere of light.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Release the shackles

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Red thorns of light swiftly coil around the luminous sphere, continuously compressing it inward.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You sense the power's struggle—it refuses to submit, determined to spread this "apocalypse" further.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You witness the Wisp transform into a near-transparent white figure, its limbs wrapped grotesquely around Yugu as it forces its fingers into her mouth, compelling her to continuously release her power.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: She is your Sinner... and the source of this devastation.

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: Will you stand by and watch as her power drains away completely, letting this story become reality?

steps.speaker: Little Wisp
steps.content: You'll save her... right?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Stay silent

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: This is your story.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Whatever ending you choose, that's what it will become.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: I will only step in to stop you if you really threaten reality and public safety.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: You won't like how that feels... so...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The crimson thorns encircling Yugu and the Wisp grow increasingly dense, lashing out like savage claws against the nimble dark mist, blocking every path it attempts to break through.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: I suggest you stop "telling" this story about yourself, rather than trying again to manipulate me into acting out your tragic ending.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Miss Yugu.
